records.name: Angular UButton
records.purpose: Standalone action component. This sample uses the same responsibility across frameworks specifically to expose different contracts rather than imply behavioral equivalence. Angular uses signal inputs and event outputs, React uses DOM props and forwarded refs, and Vue uses a base factory with props, slots and dynamic root rendering. Shared CSS is an independently consumed foundation, not another rendered component.
records.surface: Root @ultimate/ng exports UButton through src/index.ts -> ./button. There is no @ultimate/ng/button manifest subpath. Selector u-button; standalone component extends UBaseComponent. Signal inputs include label, icon, iconPos, loading, disabled, severity, raised, rounded, text, outlined, size and fluid; outputs onClick, onFocus and onBlur. Private/protected styling helpers belong to this record, not additional products.

claims.behavior: Signal-input component and native button template exist; source inspection only.
Angular button behavioral suite has not been executed for this pilot.

records.name: React UButton
records.purpose: Action button with a forwarded native HTMLButtonElement ref, inherited native button attributes, ReactNode icon/loadingIcon and optional tooltip. Internal buttonStyleModule and render helpers are owned here rather than counted independently.
records.surface: @ultimate/react/button exports UButton and type UButtonProps. UButtonProps extends Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, disabled>; properties add label, icon, iconPos, loading, loadingIcon, disabled, severity, size, text, raised, rounded, outlined, link, plain, badge, badgeClassName, visible, tooltip and tooltipOptions. Children render inside the button; visible=false returns null. The source combines disabled with loading. This is implementation evidence, not executed behavior proof.

claims.behavior: Forward-ref native button source and props exist.

records.name: Vue UButton and base factory
records.purpose: Vue action component with dynamic root tag and default slot. createBaseButton is independently callable through the same public entry, so is documented as a public surface of this owning record rather than hidden as an internal part. buttonStyleModule and computed rendering helpers remain internal ownership.
records.surface: @ultimate/vue/button exports UButton (default SFC alias) and createBaseButton. The factory declares label, icon, iconPos, iconClass, badge, badgeClass, badgeSeverity, loading, loadingIcon, as, asChild, link, severity, raised, rounded, text, outlined, size, variant, plain, fluid, ariaLabel, tooltip and tooltipOptions. The SFC uses a dynamic component root, default slot, ripple and tooltip directives, computed rootAttrs and inherited base props; asChild switches to a slot-only branch. These are not forced into the Angular or React contracts.

claims.behavior: Base props factory and dynamic-root SFC are source-present.
Vue button behavioral suite has not been executed for this pilot.

records.name: Shared button CSS
records.purpose: Framework-neutral CSS template exported as style. It supplies tokenized button states and layout rules imported by Angular and Vue style modules; React instead embeds its own small CSS string in button-style.ts; it is not a renderable component or an assertion that all consuming frameworks expose every selector.
records.surface: @ultimate/uix-styles/button exports the style string. It includes .u-button, disabled cursor, icon ordering, small/large, fluid, hover, active, focus-visible, severity, outlined, text and link rules with dt(...) token placeholders. Each framework owns its button-style adapter.

claims.behavior: Tokenized CSS exists; Angular and Vue adapters import it. React owns separate inline CSS; no shared import is claimed.
Visual behavior and token rendering are not exercised by inventory validation.
